bias.zh: 偏空 · 位于 $238 支撑之上

read.en: Arm fell 6.8% on Oct 14 to $238.01 and is down 19% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($258.0), 10-day ($279.0), 30-day ($276.7) and 100-day ($296.8) averages and 7% above the 200-day ($222.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 ($309.6), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: Arm 10月14日下跌 6.8%，收于 $238.01，五个交易日下跌 19%。股价位于 5 日（$258.0）、10 日（$279.0）、30 日（$276.7）和 100 日均线（$296.8）下方，比 200 日均线（$222.2）高 7%。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空（$309.6），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The Oct 13 bounce failed and the stock closed right on the $238 support that has held five times since July (day's low $237.55). Below it are $222 (200-day average; Sep 3 low $225.5) and $201 (May swing low). Resistance is $255–258 (Oct 12–13 closes, 5-day average), then $277–279 (30 and 10-day averages). A close below $237.5 would open $222.
read.zh: 10月13日的反弹失败，股价收在 7月以来五次守住的 $238 支撑上（当日低点 $237.55）。其下为 $222（200 日均线；9月3日低点 $225.5）和 $201（5月波段低点）。阻力为 $255–258（10月12–13日收盘价、5 日均线），其次 $277–279（30 日和 10 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $237.5，下一目标看 $222。

s.en: Held five times since July; Oct 14 low $237.55
May swing low and round number
